title: Regeneration
definition: Regeneration is the new birth, the sovereign work of the Holy Spirit by which a sinner is made spiritually alive and given a new heart.
summary: Regeneration is necessary because sinners are spiritually dead apart from grace. It is not mere moral improvement, but new life from God.
christFocus: Christ gives life to the dead. By the Spirit, believers are born from above and brought into living union with Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Regeneration is God’s work, not human self-renewal.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: It gives spiritual life, new desires, and responsiveness to God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: The new birth leads to faith, repentance, and a transformed life.
